user.title: Auckland Council Collection Schedule
user.description:
Configure Auckland Council rubbish collection information.

To find your Property ID, search for your address on the Auckland Council collection days page. The Assessment Number shown in the results is your Property ID.

Optional custom proxy: These settings are only for the private proxy service built for this integration, and require separately provided access. No public proxy service is available. Standard HTTP/HTTPS forward proxies are not supported. Leave both fields blank to connect directly to Auckland Council.

data.proxy_token: Custom proxy token (required with custom proxy URL)

error.invalid_property_id: Property ID (Assessment Number) must be a number between 5 and 15 digits
error.invalid_time_format: Time must be in HH:MM format (e.g., 07:00)
error.proxy_token_required: A custom proxy token is required when a custom proxy URL is set
error.proxy_url_required: A custom proxy URL is required when a custom proxy token is set
error.invalid_proxy_url: Custom proxy URL must start with https:// or http://
